translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Kidamwa availa bitugwali natana la bulumakau paila kalubaila lulela, ibodi bimai minana namwala kaina navivila gala isim kala nebaneba.
Matauna bisaili yamala okununa bulumakau minana oluvi bikatumati minana omatala Guyau la Buliyoyova. E Eroni dalela mayuwona tolula bikauwaisi buyavila bikatusokaisi kwemwaidona kabogwabu lula,
e oluvi yayapilela bisakaisi Guyau kala vilavila paila kaula lulela. komwaidona wala posa oyayapila,
Tolula matausina bigibugolaisi yayapila makwaisina deli lula kwegubugabu okabogwabu lula. E Guyau biyomwasali nanola metoya maiinela makwaina kaula lulela.
Kidamwa natana sipi kaina gota bivigakaisi paila kalubaila lulela bimaiyaisi namwala kaina navivila, minana gala isim kala nebaneba.
Kidamwa taitala tau bitugwali natana la sipi,
ibodi matauna bisaili yamala okununa e bikatumati minana omatala wala Buliyoyova. E tolula matausina bikauwaisi buyavila bikatusokaisi kwemwaidona kabogwabu lula,
e oluvi yayapilela bisakaisi Guyau kala vilavila paila kaula lulela. posala, yeyunala, komwaidona posa wa seila,
Oluvi tolula kasi todabala bigabu komwaidona makwaisina baisa Guyau paila kaula lulela.
Kidamwa taitala tau bitugwali natana gota,
ibodi matauna bisaili yamala okununa minana e oluvi bikatumati omatala Buliyoyova. E tolula matausina bikauwaisi buyavila bikatusokaisi kwemwaidona kabogwabu lula.
Oluvi yayapilela bisakaisi Guyau kala vilavila paila kaula lulela, komwaidona wala posa oyayapila,
E tolula bigabu komwaidona makwaisina okabogwabu lula paila kaula lulela e baisa biyomwasali Guyau nanola. E komwaidona posala baisa Guyau kala vilavila.
E ambaisa ambaisa mina Isireli eisisuaisi, posa deli buyavi gala gagabila bisuki udosi. Karaiwaga makwaina ibodi biyamataisi e bivigaki kasi gulogula baisa tubwa komwaidona.
